notes: All 20 admitted through existing private URL-only customer API; no manual workflow, source footage, per-product hints, code changes during run or relaxed guardrails.
Seven recorded provider attempts, not a verified billing count; tokens/charges not independently verified.
No output MP4 in any cohort job. No creative quality score can be assigned to absent films.
The cohort includes public product demos and browser tools, not a representative random sample of all SaaS. Historical non-overlap is limited to available receipts and handoff.
Do not use holdout URLs or outcomes for tuning or few-shot prompts. If any is used for development, retire it and establish a new untouched evaluation cohort.
